text:
samir: Quick sync — running the ClearPath Labs customer story. Need: interview, hero + expanded quote, legal OK on perf numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a 30/15 webinar the week after publish. Target publish Fri next week. Can we wrap by Wed EOD?

claire: I can do the interview Tue 10am PT. Will focus on rollout steps, infra changes, and the perf delta.

joni: I'll draft two quote options (hero + long). Aim for a punchy hero line.

ev: From infra: sanitized perf snapshot shows p50 down ~58% and p99 down ~2.7x after routing + prefix cache. Also measured ~22% lower cost per inference for the tested workload. I'll export a redacted CSV for the gated asset.

marshall: Sales ask — add post-publish lead routing: blog MQLs -> enterprise-inbound@ and AE-oncall. Also tag source=clearpath.

ops-bot: Publish slot tentatively reserved: 2026-06-11 09:00 PT. Pending legal sign-off and final copy.

samir: Legal constraints: no contract figures, no raw user counts in public post. Use qualitative phrasing like "broad production traffic" unless ClearPath confirms exact numbers.

legal-bot: Please upload signed NDA and consent: https://drive.redwood.work/ClearPath/consent-nda.pdf (viewer). Also send the interview transcript and redacted CSV for review.

joni: Draft quotes: 
- hero: "Redwood made inference fast and predictable for our production traffic."
- long: "By switching to Redwood's routing and prefix caching we reduced median latency by ~58% and improved p99 by ~2.7x, which let us enable lower-latency features while lowering per-inference cost."

claire: I'll confirm speaker name and get the hero-line approval live during the call. Will capture a 1-2 sentence speaker bio too for the webinar page.

samir: Ops — can we attach a short technical appendix with sanitized perf commands? Example skeleton:
```
# sanitized perf command
./rw_bench --model open-13b --seq 1536 --batch 6 --kv-cache --samples 1200 > bench.json
```
Legal: confirm no IP leakage and strip internal flags/datasets.

legal-bot: That skeleton is fine once internal flags are removed. Do NOT publish pricing/contract details. Allow qualitative audience phrasing only. I will review the appendix after upload; expect ~48h turnaround.

marshall: I'll queue the lead-routing rule for post-publish and test on staging. lead-router-bot will confirm.

lead-router-bot: Routing test scheduled on staging page: ok -> enterprise-inbound@, AE-oncall. Will alert when green.

ops-bot: Reminder: gated benchmark PDF should be uploaded to /campaigns/clearpath/gated/clearpath-bench-redacted.pdf before publish.

joni: I'll post the two quote options and short webinar blurb in the shared doc by EOD tomorrow.

samir: Checklist recap:
- interview scheduled (claire)
- NDA + consent uploaded (ClearPath)
- hero + long quotes captured and flagged (joni)
- legal review on text + numbers (legal-bot)
- gated benchmark PDF uploaded (ev)
- post-publish lead routing tested (marshall/lead-router-bot)
- webinar page + promo live (joni/claire)

claire: I'll send the calendar invite and include recording + consent links.

lead-router-bot: Post-publish routing confirmed on staging.

legal-bot: Will aim to complete review by Wed 4pm PT once assets are uploaded.

samir: Great work. Checkpoint Wed EOD. If green, ops-bot will flip publish and lead-router-bot will confirm handoff to sales. :thumbsup:

end of thread
